word_translation_en: to save; to rescue; to salvage
sentence_example: Der Rettungsschwimmer konnte das Kind aus dem Wasser retten.
sentence_example_translation_en: The lifeguard was able to rescue the child from the water.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Спасатель смог спасти ребенка из воды.
sentence_synonym: Der Rettungsschwimmer konnte das Kind aus dem Wasser befreien.
typical_collocations: ein Leben retten; jemanden vor dem Ertrinken retten; sich in Sicherheit retten; die Situation retten
usage_comments_en: 'retten' is the standard verb meaning to save someone or something from imminent danger, destruction, or a highly negative outcome. It often takes the preposition 'vor' + dative (to save from). In daily language, it can also be used figuratively (e.g., saving an evening or a situation) or reflexively ('sich retten' - to escape or get to safety).

sentence_example: Trotz des schweren Unfalls ist das Auto noch rettbar.
sentence_example_translation_en: Despite the severe accident, the car is still salvageable.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Несмотря на тяжелую аварию, автомобиль все еще можно спасти.
sentence_synonym: Trotz des schweren Unfalls ist das Auto noch reparabel.
typical_collocations: kaum noch rettbar; nicht mehr rettbar; eine rettbare Situation
usage_comments_en: 'rettbar' is an adjective indicating that a situation, relationship, object, or patient is capable of being salvaged or cured. It is frequently paired with negations to describe hopeless situations ('nicht mehr rettbar').

sentence_example: Das Schiff war nach der Kollision rettlos verloren.
sentence_example_translation_en: The ship was irretrievably lost after the collision.
sentence_example_translation_ru: После столкновения корабль был безнадежно потерян.
sentence_synonym: Das Schiff war nach der Kollision unrettbar verloren.
typical_collocations: rettlos verloren; rettlos versinken; rettlos veraltet
usage_comments_en: 'rettlos' is mostly used as an adverb, almost exclusively modifying words like 'verloren' (hopelessly lost) or 'verfallen' (hopelessly ruined). It expresses absolute certainty that rescue or improvement is impossible.

sentence_example: Er dankte seinem Retter für die schnelle Hilfe in der Not.
sentence_example_translation_en: He thanked his rescuer for the quick help in the emergency.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Он поблагодарил своего спасителя за быструю помощь в беде.
sentence_synonym: Er dankte seinem Erretter für die schnelle Hilfe in der Not.
typical_collocations: ein Retter in der Not; der Retter des Tages; mutige Retter; die Retter der Bergwacht
usage_comments_en: 'Retter' refers to a person who rescues someone. The phrase 'Retter in der Not' is a very common idiom meaning 'savior in times of need/distress'. It can refer to both physical rescue (e.g., firefighters) or financial/social assistance.

sentence_example: Die Rettung der Bergleute dauerte mehrere Tage.
sentence_example_translation_en: The rescue of the miners took several days.
sentence_synonym: Die Befreiung der Bergleute dauerte mehrere Tage.
typical_collocations: Rettung in letzter Sekunde; Rettung vor dem Bankrott; eine Rettung einleiten; Rettung naht
usage_comments_en: 'Rettung' is the nominal form of 'retten'. It is used in physical emergencies (ambulance, mountain rescue) as well as abstract crises (economic rescue packages).

word_translation_en: to deliver; to save; to redeem
sentence_example: Sie beteten darum, von der Tyrannei errettet zu werden.
sentence_example_translation_en: They prayed to be delivered from tyranny.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Они молились об избавлении от тирании.
sentence_synonym: Sie beteten darum, von der Tyrannei befreit zu werden.
typical_collocations: jemanden aus der Not erretten; von Sünden erretten; von dem Übel erretten
usage_comments_en: 'erretten' is a highly formal, elevated, and often religious or literary synonym of 'retten'. It is strongly associated with spiritual deliverance or being saved from an abstract, ultimate evil rather than simple everyday dangers.

word_translation_en: to carry over; to preserve (into a new era or situation)
sentence_example: Es gelang ihnen, alte Traditionen in die Moderne hinüberzuretten.
sentence_example_translation_en: They succeeded in carrying old traditions over into modern times.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Им удалось перенести старые традиции в современность.
sentence_synonym: Es gelang ihnen, alte Traditionen in die Moderne mitzunehmen.
typical_collocations: Traditionen hinüberretten; ein Erbe hinüberretten; einen Vorsprung hinüberretten; in die neue Zeit hinüberretten
usage_comments_en: 'hinüberretten' is a separable verb ('rettete hinüber', 'hinübergerettet'). It describes the act of preserving, maintaining, or carrying over something valuable (e.g., traditions, assets, sports advantages) across a critical boundary, crisis, or time period.

word_translation_en: to carry over; to prolong; to keep afloat beyond a point
word_synonyms: hinauszögern; über die Zeit retten; verlängern
sentence_example: Sie versuchten, das Unternehmen über das Jahresende hinauszuretten.
sentence_example_translation_en: They tried to keep the company afloat beyond the end of the year.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Они пытались сохранить предприятие после конца года.
sentence_synonym: Sie versuchten, das Unternehmen über das Jahresende hinaus zu verlängern.
typical_collocations: über die Krise hinausretten; über den Winter hinausretten; über das Limit hinausretten
usage_comments_en: 'hinausretten' means to save or preserve someone or something beyond a specific temporal limit, deadline, or critical period. It is separable and is regularly paired with the preposition 'über... hinaus'.

word_translation_en: to carry over into; to manage to save into
sentence_example: Er konnte seine Ersparnisse in die neue Währung hineinretten.
sentence_example_translation_en: He managed to carry his savings over into the new currency.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Ему удалось перенести свои сбережения в новую валюту.
sentence_synonym: Er konnte seine Ersparnisse in die neue Währung hineintragen.
typical_collocations: sich in das neue Jahrhundert hineinretten; Ersparnisse hineinretten; Werte hineinretten
usage_comments_en: 'hineinretten' is a separable verb focusing on carrying assets, values, or oneself successfully *into* a new period, state, or environment, often implying that this transition was difficult or required effort.

word_translation_en: to tide over; to help through (a difficult period)
sentence_example: Die finanzielle Unterstützung half ihnen, sich über den Winter hinwegzuretten.
sentence_example_translation_en: The financial support helped them to tide themselves over the winter.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Финансовая поддержка помогла им пережить зиму.
sentence_synonym: Die finanzielle Unterstützung half ihnen, den Winter zu überbrücken.
typical_collocations: sich über eine Krise hinwegretten; über den Tag hinwegretten; über schwere Zeiten hinwegretten
usage_comments_en: 'hinwegretten' is a separable verb that is commonly used reflexively ('sich über etwas hinwegretten') to describe getting oneself through or over a difficult, barren, or stressful period of time or crisis (using 'über' + accusative).
